Title: Game subtitles
Subtitle: Translate English subtitles from your PS5 in OBS.
ConnectHint: Add the script to your game scene once.
TestHint: Try a sample line before connecting the console.
SelectHint: Draw a box around the English subtitles on a game frame.
AreaReady: Subtitle area saved. Turn on the OBS virtual camera.
Help: Select your game scene in OBS. Open Tools → Scripts and click +. Paste the script path and open the file. Click the button in the script settings to add subtitles to the scene. Return to SubZir and test translation.
Checking: Reading the sample line and checking the OBS connection…
TestSuccess: OBS received the sample line. Check its position in the scene.
TestNoAck: Translation succeeded, but OBS did not confirm it. Select your game scene and repeat step 1.
Waiting: Waiting for English subtitles from the OBS virtual camera…
OcrMissing: Install English text recognition in Windows. See the guide for instructions.
CheckCamera: Check the virtual camera and select the subtitle area again.
TestFailed: The test could not finish. Open Troubleshooting in the guide.
TestEmpty: No sample line was received. Try the test again.
GettingFrame: Getting a frame from the OBS virtual camera…
NoFrame: No frame received. In OBS, start the virtual camera and repeat step 3.
LaunchError: Extract the entire ZIP to Documents and try again.
Picker: Draw a box around the area for one or two subtitle lines
SettingsError: Could not save the language settings.
GuideBody: Enable English subtitles in your game. Connect the capture card in OBS. Add the subtitle script to the game scene. Set the virtual camera output to the capture card source and start the virtual camera. In SubZir, select the subtitle area and start translation.
AddScene: Add subtitles to the current scene
CaptureSaveError: Could not save the capture settings.
ModelError: The translation model could not complete the request. See runtime/diagnostics.txt.
